title: ENIGMA R.D.E.: ten-piece overnight plate before the workshop
material: PLA Basic · right 0.4 mm · supports off

source.evidence: Clean pushed current main, complete open-PR check, feedback/inventory check, normal online print gate and retained-mesh/profile/toolpath audit passed. Source geometry unchanged; no physical acceptance. Current printer FTPS rejected upload553 and the target was absent; these new files are staged on both Macs but not transferred or started.

notes: Owner start 21:00–22:00 Oslo, 17 November;8h18m22s estimates finish 05:18–06:18 on 18 November, before 08:00. Adds both distinct rotor-shaft plugs and bracket to the earlier proposal. Black PLA Basic A3; right 0.4 mm; 0.15 mm layers (0.20 first), 3 walls, 15% infill, 5 mm outer brims; supports off; cap bridge_angle90. Exact dates/inventory are selected in CURRENT_DESIGN.workshop_strategy. Estimates are not actual usage or guaranteed finish times. Both image fields intentionally use actual first-layer GCode; no native PNG was produced. Grey paths are removable brims; purple, where present, removable same-PLA support. Cleanup, fit, strength and function remain unverified. Geometry: HdM Project ENIGMA R.D.E., Prof. Dr. Simon Wiest,397ca89,CC BY-NC-SA4.0. Owner authorized starting immediately after clearing the bed on 17 November. The upload was rejected (FTPS 553), and an exact-path lookup confirmed the intended file absent. Bambu Studio also reported external-storage read error 17. No start command was sent; this remains a planned, unstarted plate pending storage recovery and byte-identical upload readback.
previewCaption: Actual first-layer GCode for this exact slice; grey is removable brim, purple is removable same-PLA support. No native slicer bitmap was produced.
layoutCaption: The same exact first-layer GCode plot viewed from above; a separate native layout bitmap is unavailable.
